title: Outbox state machine and limits of durability
summary: The dev4 file journal records preparation, dispatch and uncertain completion; restart replay and reconciliation avoid blind reposting after ambiguous provider outcomes.
invariants: A possible side effect followed by exception is UNKNOWN and requires reconciliation; never retry from uncertainty.
Journal integrity and replay are not the same as fsync, multiwriter fencing, crash consistency or remote exactly-once delivery.
Single-process development implementation must not be advertised as production durable persistence.
Next persistence integration must use the existing estate journal/storage authority and retain publication semantics.
